messages:
sarah.docs: FYI opened a PR to correct the API ref for /v1/generate. examples still show `input: string` and `model` but runtime expects `inputs: string[]` and `model_id`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1023

ali.eng: can you paste the broken vs fixed curl so i can smoke test staging quickly?

sarah.docs: broken (current site):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model": "redwood/gpt-3x", "input": "Summarize this...", "max_new_tokens": 64}'
```
fixed (what runtime expects):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model_id": "redwood/gpt-3x", "inputs": ["Summarize this..."], "max_new_tokens": 64}'
```

mike.sdk: our JS SDK maps `input` -> `inputs` for compatibility but docs should show canonical `inputs`. i'll update the snippet in sdk PR 438 to use `inputs: ["..."]` and add a one-line compat note.

olivia.prod: please add a short migration note in the API ref top: "If you previously passed `input` (string), switch to `inputs` (array). SDKs accept both for now." also mention `model_id` vs `model`. CS will appreciate that.

ali.eng: ran fixed curl against staging 14 returns `choices` array with outputs. i'll paste the sample response into the PR. works as expected.

sarah.docs: i'll update the OpenAPI schema example to `inputs: string[]`, change the JS example to `await client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/gpt-3x', inputs: ['...'] })`, and add the migration note.

link-bot: docs link-check failed: broken internal link to /sdk/js/examples in docs/pull/1023.

mike.sdk: i'll open sdk PR 439 to fix the readme link and update deployable snippets.

sarah.docs: who can merge after link-check and a quick smoke test? want this in before tomorrow's release cut.

ali.eng: i can merge after my smoke test and CI green. ping here once link-bot is green.

olivia.prod: added to release notes draft under "API reference fixes" and will notify CS on Monday. :thumbsup:

sarah.docs: tracking: docs PR 1023 (examples + schema), sdk PR 438 (snippet), sdk PR 439 (link). i'll add the staging response sample and expected behavior to the PR description.
